validation: Offline/mock tested only; no new capability has been live-qualified.

capabilities.name: Frontier preview eligibility
capabilities.steps: Verify eligibility and existing enrollment; review applicable preview terms with the administrator.
capabilities.verification: Enrollment visible in Microsoft 365 admin center; distinguish GA from preview.

capabilities.name: Agent risk assessment
capabilities.steps: Use toolkit risk with explicit live tenant/environment; use existing tenant executor for separately approved CA plans.
capabilities.verification: Timestamped riskyAgents and agentRiskDetections results; empty results are not proof of coverage.

capabilities.name: Defender Security for AI and connectors
capabilities.steps: Inspect Security for AI setup; confirm Microsoft 365 connector components and Copilot Studio protection integration. Keep XDR-to-Sentinel separate.
capabilities.verification: Connector status plus fresh, correlated hunting/alert evidence; configuration alone is insufficient.

capabilities.name: Local agent discovery
capabilities.steps: Select test devices; review endpoint onboarding, supported platform and active Defender prerequisites.
capabilities.verification: Fresh device-specific discovery evidence; an empty inventory is inconclusive.

capabilities.name: Endpoint agent runtime protection
capabilities.steps: Select supported test devices and method; review Audit mode first. Endpoint execution is not implemented; use documented admin deployment.
capabilities.verification: Device setting readback and benign runtime demonstration; Block requires separate approval.

capabilities.name: Purview AI interaction collection
capabilities.steps: Separate opt-in for scoped collection/content capture; review users, workloads, retention and access before portal configuration.
capabilities.verification: Policy scope/status and authorized verification in Purview; never export prompts or responses into toolkit evidence.

capabilities.name: Copilot Studio agent identity verification
capabilities.steps: Inspect Entra Agent ID metadata and corresponding Entra object. New agents receive IDs automatically; assess older agents separately for migration.
capabilities.verification: Exact agent-to-Entra identity match; do not infer identity from names or catalog IDs.

capabilities.name: Third-party risk signals
capabilities.steps: Select partner; verify partner-side integration, matching identity and explicit administrator opt-in in Agents settings.
capabilities.verification: Partner-originated risk evidence matched to an agent; a toggle alone is insufficient.
